summary: Iteration 2 backend regression + bug-fix verification for Fish It automation. 36/36 pytest tests pass (20 legacy + 16 new). Verified: (a) new AutomationConfig fields already_fishing_pattern & extract_list_pattern present with correct default regexes and functional matches; (b) GET/PUT roundtrip persists them; (c) AutomationRunner.__init__ sets _last_verification_at + _in_verification; (d) _wait_for_message has extend_on_active kwarg with default; (e) resume() clears verification_url + flags; (f) _handle_verification does NOT invoke button-click helpers and uses 60s debounce via _last_verification_at and pauses; (g) _do_fishing_session and _cycle_group pass extend_on_active=True; (h) telegram_manager.UserTelegram._install_default_handler installs both events.NewMessage and events.MessageEdited (edited events pushed with type='edited'). No regressions in auth/admin/config/automation lifecycle/telegram-status endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: Real Telegram MTProto flow (send-code / login / actual /extract / /mancing / verification click) cannot be exercised in this env — verification of the three reported bug fixes is done via code plumbing + config field checks. Recommend a live end-to-end test on a real Telegram account before shipping.

AutomationRunner._handle_verification exposes verification_url to state but there is no explicit test for the /api/automation/status response including it — worth adding once a real session can trigger the flow.

extract_list_pattern default uses '.*' inside regex ('EXTRACT.*Inventory'). Case-insensitive flag is applied at compile-site; ensure all consumers pass re.IGNORECASE (checked: automation_engine._extract_and_sell uses cfg.extract_list_pattern with default fallback but does not always add IGNORECASE — verify at real runtime).
test_credentials: Admin: admin@fishit.app / Admin@Fishit2026. Test users created on-the-fly via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: ~4 disposable users created during test run (iter2_* + regtest_* + empty_* + tg_*).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend bug-fix plumbing is confirmed. Next iteration should ideally validate live: (1) /extract flow polls get_last_messages fallback and clicks 🟢 button; (2) /mancing spam is suppressed when already-fishing detected — deadline extension in _wait_for_message; (3) verification pause + Resume clears state cleanly. Frontend Configuration UI does not yet expose already_fishing_pattern / extract_list_pattern inputs, but PUT config roundtrip preserves them (as data-testid). Consider adding UI fields.
rca of the issue: N/A — no new bugs found in iteration 2. All 3 reported bug fixes verified at code + API level.
